name: Gradient-based Optimization with Surrogate Function
definition: An iterative optimization method to estimate extinction coefficients β by minimizing a cost function E(β) using a surrogate function E(β|j_all^(q)) to avoid computing the full Jacobian per gradient step.
summary: This method estimates extinction coefficients by minimizing a cost function using a surrogate to decouple expensive rendering from gradient updates, requiring only one rendering per block of steps.
